About STERN IP

One of the most effective IP offices in Egypt, the Middle East and Africa.

Patent agents specialised in registering trademarks, patents and industrial designs — and in rendering every related service.

01Who we are

A MENA pioneer in the registration and protection of IP rights.

Our firm handles payment of annuities and renewals for patents, designs and trademarks, as well as applications for assignments and license agreements, oppositions and petitions for local and international trademarks registered in Egypt — and the rendering of all related services.

STERN IP LTD is part of the Egyptian Patent Attorneys Organization and is regarded as one of the largest Intellectual Property firms in MENA on the basis of market reach, wide range of IP services and professional employees. We serve through our office in Cairo and 50 correspondents around the world.

Established in Cairo in 2008, we adhere to high ethical and professional standards and employ a qualified in-house team of professionals as well as state-of-the-art technology, providing a comprehensive range of IP services tailored to our clients’ needs.

02Our history

Since 2008.

  1. 2006

    Our founder registers as a lawyer at the Bar.

  2. 2008

    STERN IP LTD is established in Cairo; registered as trademark and patent attorneys at the Ministry of Trade.

  3. 2015

    Awarded Best IP Firm in Egypt.

  4. 2018

    Contributed to updating the Egyptian intellectual property law alongside the Trademark Office.

  5. 2019

    Best IP Firm in Egypt, again — and ranked among the top 5 IP firms in Egypt by Managing Intellectual Property.

  6. Today

    11 offices across the Arab world and Africa and 50 liaison and correspondent offices worldwide.
